findings.title: Gestation as enclosure, settling, and churn
findings.claim: The focus labor episode can be read as the active disturbance of an enclosed, inward-bearing life that is moving toward delivery, with falling retaining the risk of premature loss and settling marking the bodily state that the following provision answers.
findings.mechanism: The enclosure occurrence at 19:17 meets pregnancy-bearing at 19:22; the focus word's ordinary labor facet and its packet-supplied liquid-agitation facet meet the later falling at 19:25 and settling at 19:26. The same pericope therefore changes the focus from an isolated pain report into a bounded sequence of enclosure, agitation, risk, and stabilization.
findings.reader_payoff: The labor word remains ordinary labor while the reader can also perceive the contained bodily process that the surrounding scene is bringing to a threshold.
findings.containment: This does not translate the focus as liquid agitation or miscarriage. Those are contextual branch resonances around the supplied labor reading, and the packet does not establish a medical claim beyond the stated enclosure, movement, falling, and settling images.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence is trusted and all pericope carriers are supplied, while several non-focus facets are contextual split-sense activations rather than independently analyzed focus morphology.

findings.containment: The focus remains a labor-driven arrival and lament. The harvest operation is a pericope-level contextual movement, and it does not claim that the focus itself narrates the later shaking or fruit release.

epistemic.reason: The repeated trunk and each harvest stage are directly supplied by the focus and adjacent context occurrences.

findings.title: Speech reassigned
findings.claim: Mary's voiced lament becomes the hinge before explanatory agency passes through silence and gesture to the child's voice.
findings.mechanism: The focus saying at 19:23 is followed by the prescribed withholding of speech and intelligible exchange at 19:26, a bodily indication at 19:29, and the child's saying at 19:30. The same speech field returns through the focus qac occurrence, changing the lament from an isolated utterance into the beginning of a transfer in who can answer the social crisis.
findings.reader_payoff: The silence after the lament becomes structurally active: it prepares a different form of testimony rather than simply ending Mary's speech.
findings.containment: The focus remains Mary's own spoken lament. The redistribution is attributed HFT evidence, and ritual silence followed by a separate miracle remains a live alternative.

epistemic.reason: The trace supplies exact speech, silence, gesture, and child-speech coordinates with a focus return; three branch records remain unresolved.

branch_activations.activation: Mary's saying and the child's later saying are separated by silence and gesture, so the speech field returns with a changed speaker.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus lament is the last direct disclosure before the burden of public explanation moves elsewhere.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace does not decide whether the child's speech is caused by Mary's silence; it records the supplied sequence.

branch_activations.boundary: The gesture is not assigned a specific unspoken sentence beyond its role in the supplied trace.

findings.title: Compelled, then accused
findings.claim: Mary is first made to come by labor and later addressed as though she had come bearing the extraordinary matter, so the pericope reverses the apparent location of agency.
findings.mechanism: The focus causative-coming occurrence places Mary as the object of labor's force; 19:27 repeats the coming field with Mary as the agent who has brought the matter, while the people supply the social address and the charged object. The repeated root meets a changed grammatical role and turns the focus lament into a point of threatened agency reversal.
findings.reader_payoff: The wish to have died beforehand can be heard beside the prospect of being held responsible for what the bodily sequence imposed on her.
findings.containment: The focus does not state that Mary anticipates the later accusation. Pain and immediate anguish remain live explanations; the agency reversal is attributed contextual evidence.

epistemic.reason: The HFT names exact focus and 19:27 coordinates and a repeated-root mechanism, but all four branch records are unresolved.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus causative-coming occurrence carries Mary as the one driven to an endpoint.

branch_activations.activation: The same coming field meets opposite agency roles across the focus and 19:27.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The event first happens to Mary and later appears in public address as something she has brought.
branch_activations.boundary: No unresolved branch gloss is invented, and the focus form is not retranslated as ordinary voluntary coming.

branch_activations.carrier: The 19:27 occurrence carries Mary as the one who has come bearing the matter.

branch_activations.activation: Public address recasts the earlier compelled movement as a personally authored arrival.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The later social grammar places responsibility on the person whom bodily grammar had made an object.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not claim that the people understand the bodily compulsion.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threatened burden in the focus is social as well as physical: a community can name her as author of the event.
branch_activations.boundary: The exact social response is limited to the supplied 19:27 address.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Mary's wished-for erasure can be heard beside the prospect of being made the visible bearer of an extraordinary charge.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not add a legal judgment or infer a complete account of the community's motives.

findings.title: Temporal sequence restored
findings.claim: The focus's wish moves death to before the present threshold, while the later birth-death-renewed-life sequence places those events in an ordered progression.
findings.mechanism: The focus temporal occurrence and death occurrence supply the attempted precedence; 19:33 supplies birth, death, and being raised alive in sequence. The later order meets the focus's inversion without cancelling its anguish, so the focus's before becomes a temporal pressure within a larger ordered life sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The word before gains structural weight: it marks an attempted relocation in time that the later declaration allows the reader to perceive against an ordered sequence.
findings.containment: The later sequence is not treated as a direct reply to Mary's mind, and the focus's death wish remains fully present. The restoration is a qualified attributed reading.

epistemic.reason: The HFT supplies exact focus and 19:33 coordinates, a changed reading, and a focus return; the birth branch record is unresolved and the trace is medium-confidence in its source payload.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus does more than locate death earlier; it presses against the order that the later declaration articulates.
branch_activations.boundary: The later sequence is not asserted to be a conscious correction addressed to Mary.

findings.title: Palm as sieve
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the palm-and-harvest scene forms a sorting image in which ripe choice fruit is retained while Mary imagines herself as the forgotten residue.
findings.mechanism: The focus palm occurrence is paired with the focus's discarded-object wording; 19:25 supplies ripe dates and gathered produce. The supplied sifting facet of the palm root meets the selected-yield and forgotten-remnant images, creating an analogy between harvest sorting and Mary's self-classification.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's wish to be forgotten can be perceived as a wish to occupy the residue side of a scene that is simultaneously producing what is chosen and nourishing.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory branch-image analogy, not an alternative lexical translation of palm and not a claim that Mary consciously compares herself to sieve residue. The primary tree and lament remain recoverable.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies focus and context coordinates, but labels the relation exploratory and leaves one branch unresolved; its own containment limits are retained.

branch_activations.boundary: The palm remains a palm tree in the primary reading; the sifting facet is exploratory and analogical.

findings.title: Before the receiving threshold
findings.claim: The focus's temporal before can exploratorily carry an image of escape before reaching the bodily threshold where new life is received.
findings.mechanism: The focus labor occurrence places the speech at the delivery threshold, the focus before occurrence supplies temporal priority, and 19:33 explicitly supplies birth later in the unit. These contacts allow the receiving-threshold facet of the before root to color the temporal wish without changing its syntax.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase before this can be heard as a wish to have escaped the threshold itself, while still plainly meaning before the present event.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory, attributed branch resonance. The focus form remains temporal before; the receiving image is not a lexical replacement and does not assert Mary's conscious anticipation of childbirth as threshold.

epistemic.reason: The HFT supplies exact focus and 19:33 coordinates and an explicit containment note, while the birth branch registry is unresolved and the relation is marked exploratory.
